premises: Cold rolling introduces deformation twins in coarse grains at room temperature
Partial recrystallization retains these twins in non-recrystallized grains
Retained twins and non-recrystallized grains significantly increase yield strength
Additional twinning during tensile deformation occurs in both recrystallized and non-recrystallized regions, preserving ductility
The mechanism is transferable to other HEA systems like NbTaHfTiZrV0.5
